_comment: Plugin CTA destinations for this site. Mirrors the lane entries in the shared plugins-links.json (golden-hour, packing-checklist) so the render side has one typed source of truth. `href` is the tracked destination URL; while it is empty the PluginCta block stays silent and ships NO link. Paste the URL from plugins-links.json to turn a block on. Never commit a guessed or unverified link: the site's rule is no dead links.

goldenHour.text: Planning when to be on the water? Sunvane Golden Hour, a free plugin for ChatGPT and Claude, gives sunrise, sunset and golden-hour times for any city and date.

packingChecklist.text: Packwise Checklist, a free plugin for ChatGPT and Claude, turns your trip into a printable packing list with a PDF.
